subject: Follow-up: commit breakpoints, target $/1M & founder credit
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: commit breakpoints, target $/1M & founder credit

Alex — great talking earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put a proposal together:  

Call highlights
- Nimble’s initial pilot (Q4) target: 5–10M tokens / month.
- Expected ramp: reach ~300M tokens / month by Q3 2028 if evaluation metrics hold.
- Key use: real-time triage + summary generation (latency-sensitive paths) — will need small low-latency pools and a larger batch pool for bulk transforms.

Pricing context / ask
- You mentioned a target unit of ~$600–$800 per 1M tokens for steady-state. For context, our current list for the recommended model here is $1,000 / 1M tokens (hosted) before any commit discounts or founder credits.
- To get to your target we typically combine: committed-use discount + founder/accelerator credit for 3 months + multi-year rebates for uptime/commitment.

Deliverables I’m attaching:
- nimble_burn_estimate.xlsx (rough ramp & cost sensitivity worksheet)
- redwood_startup_credits.pdf (outline of founder credit eligibility and what we typically require)

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the internal budget range for year 1 (ballpark $)? Knowing a $/month or $/quarter range is really helpful — e.g., $3k–$10k/mo vs $30k–$100k/mo moves us to different commit bands.
2) Please share the procurement contact (email) so we can coordinate PO timing and any required contract clauses.
3) Are you flexible on a 12 vs 24 month committed-use horizon? That materially changes the discount depth we can offer.

I’ll draft 2 quick options: (A) 12-month commit with founder credit applied first 3 months; (B) 24-month with a steeper year-2 rebate. If you can answer the bullets above I’ll have a proposal by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks — enjoyed the demo discussion.

— Aditya

From: Alex Moreno <alex@nimblehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: commit breakpoints, target $/1M & founder credit

Thanks Aditya — nice summary. Confirming the immediate answers you asked for:  

Budget / ramping notes
- Pilot (Q4): we can commit to ~5–10M tokens/mo under a trial agreement (budgeted).
- If the pilot hits our KPIs we’ll scale: projected steady-state by mid/late 2028 is 200–350M tokens/mo.
- Year 1 spend range (conservative): $25k–$85k total (we know that’s a wide band; open to narrowing once you send model + scenario pricing).

Procurement
- Procurement contact: procurement@nimblehealth.com (CCed on this thread). They typically need a SOW + blanket PO; lead time ~2–3 weeks once terms are agreed.

Founder credit & commitment length
- We are early-stage and qualify for founder/accelerator credits; would prefer those stacked with any committed-use discounts.
- We’d favor a 12-month commitment to start, but if there’s a significant incentive to 24 months (e.g., meaningful year-2 rebate) we can consider it.

Can you include concrete $/1M examples for: no-commit (list), 12‑mo commit at 3 common bands (small, mid, large), and a 24‑mo path with a year-2 rebate? Also a “sticker” for founder credit (how much $/1M it offsets and for how many months).

I’ll get procurement to share any standard terms they require. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Product & Integrations | NimbleHealth
alex@nimblehealth.com

Attachment(s): nimble_po_request.pdf (procurement note)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>

Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: commit breakpoints, target $/1M & founder credit

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Alex’s reply. Key asks: concrete $/1M examples for list, 12mo tiers, and 24mo with year-2 rebate; confirm founder credit stacking. Procurement contact is procurement@nimblehealth.com.

My suggested approach (quick math / proposal sketch):
- List (no-commit, hosted recommended model): $1,000 / 1M tokens.
- 12-month commit bands (sample):
  - Band A (pilot-ish): 5–30M tokens/mo avg -> ~10% discount => $900 / 1M
  - Band B (scale): 30–150M tokens/mo avg -> ~30% discount => $700 / 1M
  - Band C (enterprise): 150M+ tokens/mo avg -> ~40% discount => $600 / 1M
- Founder credit: up to $150 / 1M equivalent credit for first 3 months (applied to invoice) for qualifying startups (matches their ask to get nearer to $600–$800 target).
- 24-month path: same bands with an additional year-2 rebate of 10–15% applied retroactively if committed thresholds are met (effectively driving year-2 blended $/1M down by 10–15%).

Example scenario: if they ramp to Band B by month 6 and meet year spend: effective blended (12mo) ~ $720 / 1M after founder credit applied in early months. Year-2 blended could fall to ~$610 / 1M with rebate.

Risks / notes:
- Low-latency reserved pool costs are slightly higher; we can reserve a small low-latency slice and keep most volume on a cheaper batch profile to hit target economics.
- Any significant custom integrations or security review (e.g., additional audit logs or custom VPC peering) should be scoped separately — don’t bake into unit price.

Next actions I propose:
1) Ben + Marissa: confirm we can offer the founder credit stacking and sign-off on the 24mo rebate banding.
2) I’ll prepare a two-option pricing PDF: Option A (12mo with founder credit) and Option B (24mo with year-2 rebate) and include PO/contract timeline assumptions.
3) We’ll send to procurement for initial redlines and aim for a PO within 10 business days once they confirm band and SOW.

Thoughts?

— Aditya

Subject: Proposed pricing + docs (12mo vs 24mo) — NimbleHealth

Alex / Procurement team — attaching the proposal and a draft MA for procurement review. High level summary below, attachments: proposed_pricing_nimble_20270714.pdf, ma-commit-terms-draft.docx.

Quick summary (concrete $/1M examples)
- No-commit (list): $1,000 / 1M tokens.
- 12-month commit (applied based on achieved avg monthly tokens across months):
  - Band A (5–30M/mo avg): $900 / 1M
  - Band B (30–150M/mo avg): $700 / 1M
  - Band C (150M+/mo avg): $600 / 1M
- Founder credit: $150 / 1M equivalent credit for first 3 months, stackable with the commit discount (applied as invoice credit).
- 24-month option: same commit bands, plus an annual retroactive rebate in year 2 of 10% of year-2 bill if committed thresholds are met (effectively drives year-2 blended price ~10% lower).

Example math (illustrative):
- Pilot month at 8M tokens (Band A): invoice = 8 * $900 = $7,200, then founder credit applied (equiv $150/1M) => credit $1,200 -> net $6,000 for that month.

Procurement notes
- Draft MA includes standard data protection appendices and a 30-day PO lead assumption. If procurement requires custom SCAs or custom audit windows, we’ll scope separately (possible onboarding fee).

Requested confirmation
1) Can procurement share any contract template redlines within 3 business days?
2) Can Alex confirm whether Band A pilot is acceptable to sign as a 12-month commit (we can include an early-exit clause tied to KPIs if helpful)?
3) If they want the 24-month path, we’ll add a year-2 rebate schedule and updated SOW noting expected ramp milestones.

We’re happy to hop on a 30-min call with procurement to walk through the MA and timing next week.

Thanks — attaching the PDFs now.

— Aditya
